title: Evidence-based performance diagnosis
rawUserRequest: Execute WI-12 of the authorized performance-first improvement plan. Diagnose governance execution bottlenecks from repository-local evidence, including duplicated verification, explicit CI/resource contention waits, and comparable before/after baselines where available. Produce reproducible machine-readable and human-readable output without changing gates, trust decisions, scheduling, or runtime behavior.

declaredIntent.summary: Explain where governed execution time is spent and whether repeated verification or resource waiting is observable, while preserving evidence boundaries.

outOfScope: Changing gate results, trust decisions, required verification, or fail-closed behavior
Changing scheduler, parallel execution, cache, provider, runtime, or CI orchestration behavior
Estimating token/provider cost, human time, or unrecorded resource contention
Modifying governance-cost collection semantics, WI-11 control policy, or WI-13 adoption reporting
Treating a single run or inferred correlation as proof of causal improvement

sources.reason: Existing evidence-only Work Item diagnosis and event loader to extend compatibly.
Canonical lifecycle, gate, explicit wait, and retry accounting semantics.
Canonical local event envelope and duration fields.
Existing focused behavior and CLI coverage.
Current evidence-only documentation and unknown boundary.
Related schema vocabulary and advisory output constraints.

riskAssessment.reason: Diagnosis must distinguish measured timing, explicit waiting, repetition, and unavailable causal evidence without affecting trust decisions.

reasons: Evidence schema and report semantics require strict verification; output remains advisory-only.

executionDecision.reason: The Contract bounds a local evidence-only diagnosis and explicitly excludes policy or execution changes.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The report identifies measured bottlenecks with source category, observed duration, and deterministic ranking; unavailable timing remains unknown.
Repeated verification is reported only when the same check identity is explicitly observed more than once, with run/count evidence and no causal overclaim.
Explicit CI or resource contention waits are attributed separately from local compute and gate duration; absent or ambiguous contention remains unknown.
A comparable baseline report can be supplied to produce before/after deltas only for matching measured fields, while mismatched or missing baselines produce an explicit limitation.

The CLI emits reproducible JSON plus human-readable Markdown with source digest, evidence limitations, advisory decisionImpact=none, and schema validation; focused tests cover complete, partial, malformed, repeated, contention, and baseline scenarios.
Documentation states the command, event vocabulary, evidence boundary, reproducibility method, and why diagnosis does not change governance execution.
guidelines: Use only explicit repository-local event evidence; never infer unavailable duration or causality.
Keep diagnosis advisory-only with decisionImpact=none; do not bypass or rewrite gates, scheduling, or trust decisions.
Treat repeated checks and contention as observations, not defects, unless the evidence explicitly states a reason.
Bind output to source digests and stable sorted serialization so another agent can reproduce it from the same input.
Document every new public function and preserve unknown semantics in both JSON and Markdown.

intent.problem: The current report ranks basic measured durations but does not explain repeated verification, explicit resource contention, or comparable before-and-after movement, making real execution delays difficult to diagnose without speculation.
constraints: Use repository-local observability and supplied baseline reports only.
Keep malformed, cross-item, missing, and ambiguous evidence fail-closed or explicitly unknown.
Do not alter runtime, scheduler, gate, policy, or lifecycle decisions.
intent.rationale: A reproducible diagnostic projection lets later optimization work target measured bottlenecks while retaining calibrated trust and preventing performance claims from outrunning evidence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A complete event fixture contains phases, gates, repeated checks, and explicit CI/resource waits.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The report separates local/gate/wait durations, records repeated verification evidence, and deterministically ranks measured bottlenecks.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused deterministic fixture assertions and CLI output validation.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A comparable prior report is supplied with matching measured fields.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Before/after delta and percentage are emitted only for numeric matching values; the source identity is preserved.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused baseline comparison tests including missing and mismatched evidence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Evidence is partial, malformed, cross-Work-Item, or ambiguous about contention.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Malformed input fails closed; cross-item data is excluded; unavailable or ambiguous values remain unknown and no bottleneck claim is fabricated.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized the complete 14-WI implementation plan, including WI-12 performance diagnosis.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
